preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The number of people living in Hanh's apartment is between 2 and 1000, inclusive.
The number of steel chains required is between 1 and n, inclusive.
The weights of the fridges are non-negative integers up to 10,000.

postconditions.expression: output is either -1 or a non-negative integer
postconditions.description: The output should be -1 if there is no solution, or the minimum total cost of the steel chains if there is a solution.

postconditions.expression: if output is not -1, then it should contain exactly m lines of (u_i, v_i) pairs
postconditions.description: Each line should contain two integers representing the fridges connected by a steel chain.

invariants.description: No steel chain connects a fridge to itself.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= u_i, v_i <= n for all i)
invariants.description: Each fridge is connected by a steel chain to another fridge within the range of n.
The weight of each fridge is non-negative.
